0022600015.text: The Washington Wizards (2-3, 9th in the East, on a two-game losing streak) host the Charlotte Hornets (3-2, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East) in the sixth game of the Wizards' season and an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Tre Johnson is day-to-day with Achilles soreness and a game-time decision, while Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery), with Dennis Schroder listed as day-to-day with a foot injury. Washington trails 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing the last meeting 110-103 in Charlotte on October 26, and it was swept 0-4 by the Hornets in the 2025-26 season series.
